summary: Cheetah Net Supply Chain Service Inc. filed an 8-K reporting mutual termination of an at-the-market (ATM) equity sales agreement with AC Sunshine Securities LLC. The agreement, effective March 31, 2026, allowed periodic sales of Class A common stock. Before termination on June 26, 2026, the company sold 2,775,000 post-split shares. No further placements or fees were owed. This routine termination of a prior equity line is not a special situation. No deal terms, disruption, or strategic shift is present, only an administrative closure of a capital facility.
